Cloudy tap water is usually just air 💧
The Drinking Water Inspectorate says white or cloudy water is normally tiny air bubbles, often after the water's been turned off nearby, like a burst main. Pour a glass: if it clears from the bottom up, it's air. It's not harmful to health and should normally clear within 24 hours. If it lasts longer or tastes or smells odd, contact your water supplier. Cloudy every time? Check your stop tap is fully open.

Has your tap ever run white? Comment your town 👇
Source: Drinking Water Inspectorate, DWQR Scotland
